title: Radial dither bloom

reference.source: Reference 19: dithered radial bloom in indigo and pale yellow, 735 × 920 px JPEG.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: A blurred picture of beads of light on radial rays, a lit square panel with a halo at its edges and a petal ring at the center, posterized through a scaled Bayer dither to five inks.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 735 × 920 and every length scales with the canvas

cell.does: Size of one cell of the 4 × 4 Bayer tile on the sheet; the reference's tile measures 4.4 px.

depth.does: How far the tile pushes each color before the nearest ink prints; 0 posterizes every pixel to its nearest ink, 1 spans 160 levels.

grain.does: Share of the threshold taken from per-pixel noise; 1 replaces the ordered tile with white noise.

soft.does: Blur of the dithered sheet; 0 keeps every cell hard, the reference's file carries about 0.8 px.

blur.does: Softening of the picture before it is dithered; the lobes' edges are this soft.

rays.does: Number of radial rays the beads sit on.

beads.does: Beads of light along each ray, brighter outward.

size.does: Radius of the beads; the outer ones are about twice the inner.

reach.does: How far out along the rays the beads go; above 1 they leave the sheet.

twist.does: Spiral turn of the rays with radius.

spin.does: Rotation of the whole ray set.

scatter.does: Random offset of each bead off its ray.

ring.does: Radius of the petal ring at the center.

frame.does: Half width of the lit square panel as a share of the sheet's half width.

panelLight.does: How much the ground lifts inside the panel.

halo.does: Brightness of the glow along the panel's edges.

seed.does: Re-rolls the bead scatter and the noise share.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: The center: a petal ring of yellow with a dark hole, the one hard shape on the sheet.

techniques.name: Tone
techniques.implementation: A bead: yellow at its heart, dithering to lilac and violet across about 20 px of blur.

techniques.name: Pull
techniques.implementation: An outer bead crossing the panel edge: brighter, and on the black ground outside the panel.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: Panel field between rays: indigo and violet in a Bayer pattern, 4.4 px tile.

pass_order: soft picture at half resolution: indigo ground, a square panel that lifts the ground inside it, a gaussian halo along the panel's edges
beads: N rays, each with beads of light at rising radius, elongated 1.9:1 along the ray, brighter and larger outward
a petal ring at the center (cosine petals on a ring, a dark hole inside)
ordered dither: a 4 × 4 Bayer tile scaled to the sheet, mixed with a small noise share, pushes each pixel's color by the dither depth and the nearest of five inks prints
softness: the dithered sheet is blurred by 0.8 px, as the file is

dither.method: 2-D FFT peaks in the lobe, ground and corner patches; a 4 × 4 Bayer tile of cell 1.1 px has its first harmonics at 2.2 px on the axes and 3.1 px on the diagonals

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Indigo bloom palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The rays and beads are generated, so the lobe and lobe-edge rects were placed with search.py; the ground corner, the panel field and the whole plate compare in place.

limits: Under 98 % on most metrics (mean 0.75). The reference's dither alternates yellow with indigo cells inside the lobes, a push of about 150 levels, while the panel alternates indigo with lilac, a push of about 80; one dither depth cannot do both, and the nearest-ink rule at a depth of 1 leaves the lobes nearly solid. A per-region depth was not built.
The reference is a soft JPEG of a hard dither; the 0.8 px softness slider closes part of the histogram gap and none of the autocorrelation gap at lag 4.
The rays, beads and panel are generated; the reference's kaleidoscope is not traced.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
